about: Career paths: stages, skills (status todo | learning | done) and trackers. Skills marked from your projects list the evidence. Edit on the site or tell Claude.

paths.title: AI Engineer
paths.tagline: Build, ship and evaluate products on top of large language models and machine learning.

stages.title: Foundations
stages.summary: The tools every AI engineer uses daily: Python, Git, the shell, data handling and the maths under the models.

skills.title: Python, properly
skills.detail: Typing, dataclasses, generators, async, packaging with uv or pip, virtual envs.

skills.title: Git and GitHub
skills.detail: Branches, pull requests, rebasing, Actions for CI. Commit every day.

skills.title: Linux and the shell
skills.detail: Navigating, pipes, grep/sed, ssh, environment variables, cron.

skills.title: NumPy and pandas
skills.detail: Vectorised maths, indexing, groupby, joins, reshaping, time series.

skills.title: SQL for engineers
skills.detail: Joins, CTEs, window functions, indexes. Most AI data still lives in Postgres.

skills.title: Linear algebra
skills.detail: Vectors, matrices, dot products, eigenvectors, SVD. The language of embeddings.

skills.title: Probability and statistics
skills.detail: Distributions, Bayes, hypothesis tests, confidence intervals, sampling.

skills.title: Calculus for ML
skills.detail: Derivatives, chain rule, gradients. Enough to follow backprop by hand.

stages.title: Machine learning
stages.summary: Classical ML end to end: framing a problem, building features, training, validating and explaining models.

skills.title: Supervised learning
skills.detail: Linear and logistic regression, kNN, SVM, decision trees. When to use which.

skills.title: Feature engineering
skills.detail: Encoding, scaling, leakage, lag features, target encoding, feature selection.

skills.title: Model evaluation
skills.detail: Train/val/test splits, cross-validation, precision/recall, ROC, calibration.

skills.title: Tree ensembles
skills.detail: Random forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, tuning with Optuna.

skills.title: Unsupervised learning
skills.detail: k-means, DBSCAN, PCA, UMAP, anomaly detection.

skills.title: scikit-learn pipelines
skills.detail: Pipelines, ColumnTransformer, custom transformers, model persistence.

skills.title: Explainability
skills.detail: SHAP, permutation importance, partial dependence. Explain a model to a PM.

stages.title: Deep learning
stages.summary: Neural networks from the ground up, then the architectures that power modern AI, ending at the transformer.

learn.t: Andrej Karpathy: Neural Networks, Zero to Hero

skills.title: Neural nets and backprop
skills.detail: Build a tiny autograd engine, then an MLP. Know what a gradient step does.

skills.title: PyTorch
skills.detail: Tensors, autograd, Dataset/DataLoader, training loops, saving and loading.

skills.title: CNNs and vision
skills.detail: Convolutions, ResNets, transfer learning, image classification.

skills.title: Sequence models
skills.detail: RNNs, LSTMs, BiLSTM-CRF for tagging.

skills.title: Transformers and attention
skills.detail: Self-attention, positional encodings, encoder vs decoder. Build a mini GPT.

skills.title: Training at scale
skills.detail: GPUs, mixed precision, gradient accumulation, distributed basics.

stages.title: LLM foundations
stages.summary: How large language models work and how to drive them well: tokens, embeddings, prompting, APIs and fine-tuning.

skills.title: Tokenisation and text processing
skills.detail: BPE, token counts, cleaning, lemmatisation, why tokens cost money.

skills.title: Embeddings
skills.detail: Sentence embeddings, similarity, choosing and evaluating an embedding model.

skills.title: Hugging Face ecosystem
skills.detail: transformers, datasets, tokenizers, the Hub, pipelines.

skills.title: Prompt engineering
skills.detail: System prompts, few-shot, chain of thought, structured outputs, prompt versioning.

skills.title: LLM APIs
skills.detail: Claude, Gemini and OpenAI APIs: streaming, tool use, JSON mode, prompt caching, batching.

skills.title: Fine-tuning LLMs
skills.detail: LoRA and QLoRA, instruction data, when fine-tuning beats prompting.

skills.title: Open and local models
skills.detail: Llama, Qwen, Mistral; Ollama and quantisation for running models locally.

stages.title: LLM applications
stages.summary: The heart of the job: retrieval, agents and tools that turn a model into a product.

skills.title: Retrieval-augmented generation
skills.detail: Chunking, indexing, retrieval, grounding answers with citations.

skills.title: Vector databases
skills.detail: Qdrant, pgvector, FAISS. Filters, HNSW, payloads.

skills.title: Hybrid search and reranking
skills.detail: BM25 + vectors, reciprocal rank fusion, cross-encoder rerankers.

skills.title: Agents and tool use
skills.detail: Tool calling, planning loops, memory, self-correction, human in the loop.

skills.title: Agent frameworks
skills.detail: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Claude Agent SDK: know one deeply.

skills.title: Model Context Protocol
skills.detail: Build MCP servers that expose tools and data to any AI client.

skills.title: Multimodal AI
skills.detail: Vision inputs, document parsing, speech to text, image generation.

skills.title: Guardrails and safety
skills.detail: Input/output validation, prompt-injection defence, PII handling, quality gates.

stages.title: Evals and reliability
stages.summary: What separates demos from products: measuring quality, tracing failures and controlling cost.

learn.t: Hamel Husain: Your AI product needs evals

skills.title: LLM evals
skills.detail: Golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, pairwise comparisons, regression suites in CI.

skills.title: RAG evaluation
skills.detail: Retrieval recall@k, faithfulness, answer relevance, RAGAS-style metrics.

skills.title: Tracing and observability
skills.detail: Langfuse, LangSmith or OpenTelemetry traces, logging prompts and costs.

skills.title: Cost and latency
skills.detail: Caching, streaming, model routing, batching, small models where they suffice.

stages.title: Shipping to production
stages.summary: Serve, containerise, deploy and monitor AI systems like a software engineer.

skills.title: APIs with FastAPI
skills.detail: Pydantic models, async endpoints, streaming responses, auth.

skills.title: Testing
skills.detail: pytest, fixtures, mocking LLM calls, end-to-end tests with Playwright.

skills.title: Docker and Compose
skills.detail: Images, multi-stage builds, Compose for app + vector DB.

skills.title: CI/CD
skills.detail: GitHub Actions: lint, test, build, deploy on every push.

skills.title: Cloud deployment
skills.detail: Deploy to AWS, GCP or Azure: containers, serverless, secrets, IAM basics.

skills.title: Kubernetes basics
skills.detail: Deployments, services, autoscaling for model servers.

skills.title: MLOps
skills.detail: Experiment tracking (MLflow, W&B), model registry, data versioning.

skills.title: Model serving
skills.detail: vLLM, TGI, batching and GPUs for self-hosted models.

stages.title: System design and hiring
stages.summary: Turn the skills into an offer: design interviews, DSA, a sharp portfolio and lots of applications.

learn.t: Chip Huyen: Designing Machine Learning Systems

skills.title: ML system design
skills.detail: Design recommendation, search, fraud and ranking systems end to end.

skills.title: AI system design
skills.detail: Design a RAG assistant, an agent platform, an eval pipeline under constraints.

skills.title: DSA for interviews
skills.detail: Arrays, hashing, two pointers, trees, graphs, DP. NeetCode 150.

skills.title: Portfolio with 3 flagship projects
skills.detail: Live demos, clean READMEs, architecture diagrams and eval results.

skills.title: Resume and LinkedIn
skills.detail: One page, impact numbers, AI engineer keywords, open to work.

skills.title: Mock interviews
skills.detail: Technical, system design and behavioural rounds with feedback.

skills.title: Applications and outreach
skills.detail: Targeted applications, referrals, recruiter messages every week.

paths.title: Data Analyst
paths.tagline: Turn messy data into decisions with SQL, statistics, dashboards and clear stories.

stages.title: Spreadsheets and business sense
stages.summary: Where most analysis still starts: Excel, the metrics a business runs on, and asking the right question.

skills.title: Excel essentials
skills.detail: XLOOKUP, IF/IFS, SUMIFS, text and date functions, data validation.

skills.title: Pivot tables and charts
skills.detail: Pivot tables, slicers, pivot charts, quick summaries.

skills.title: Excel dashboards
skills.detail: A one-page KPI dashboard with dynamic ranges and slicers.

skills.title: Business metrics and KPIs
skills.detail: Revenue, margin, CAC, LTV, churn, conversion, retention.

skills.title: Problem framing
skills.detail: Turn a vague ask into a question, a metric and a decision.

stages.title: SQL
stages.summary: The analyst's daily language. Fluency here wins most interviews on its own.

skills.title: SELECT, filter, aggregate
skills.detail: WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, CASE WHEN.

skills.title: Joins
skills.detail: Inner, left, self and anti joins; avoiding duplicate rows.

skills.title: Subqueries and CTEs
skills.detail: Readable multi-step queries with WITH.

skills.title: Window functions
skills.detail: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG/LEAD, running totals, moving averages.

skills.title: Dates and strings in SQL
skills.detail: DATE_TRUNC, intervals, cohorts by month, string cleaning.

skills.title: Query performance
skills.detail: Indexes, EXPLAIN, avoiding SELECT *, partitioned tables.

stages.title: Statistics
stages.summary: Knowing when a difference is real. The part that makes an analyst trustworthy.

skills.title: Descriptive statistics
skills.detail: Mean, median, spread, percentiles, outliers, distributions.

skills.title: Probability
skills.detail: Conditional probability, marginal tables, Bayes in practice.

skills.title: Hypothesis testing
skills.detail: t-tests, chi-square, ANOVA, p-values and what they do not mean.

skills.title: Confidence intervals and CLT
skills.detail: Sampling distributions, bootstrap, margin of error.

skills.title: A/B testing
skills.detail: Experiment design, sample size, power, guardrail metrics.

skills.title: Regression analysis
skills.detail: Linear regression, interpreting coefficients, assumptions.

stages.title: Python for analysis
stages.summary: Repeatable analysis that scales past what a spreadsheet can hold.

skills.title: pandas
skills.detail: Loading, cleaning, merging, groupby, pivot, time series.

skills.title: Data cleaning
skills.detail: Missing values, types, duplicates, outliers, tidy data.

skills.title: Exploratory data analysis
skills.detail: Univariate, bivariate, segment comparisons, writing up insights.

skills.title: Visualisation in Python
skills.detail: Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly. Charts that answer one question each.

skills.title: Notebooks to reports
skills.detail: Clean Jupyter notebooks, exported reports, reproducible runs.

stages.title: BI and storytelling
stages.summary: Dashboards people actually open, and the story that makes them act.

skills.title: Tableau
skills.detail: Calculated fields, LOD expressions, parameters, dashboard actions.

skills.title: Power BI
skills.detail: Power Query, data model, DAX measures, publishing.

skills.title: DAX
skills.detail: CALCULATE, filter context, time intelligence.

skills.title: Dashboard design
skills.detail: Layout, hierarchy, colour, one decision per view.

skills.title: Data storytelling
skills.detail: Lead with the answer, show the evidence, recommend an action.

stages.title: Analytics in the business
stages.summary: The analyses companies hire for: funnels, retention, segments and forecasts.

skills.title: Product analytics
skills.detail: Funnels, activation, DAU/MAU, feature adoption.

skills.title: Cohorts and retention
skills.detail: Cohort tables, retention curves, churn analysis.

skills.title: Customer segmentation
skills.detail: RFM, profiling, clustering customers into actionable groups.

skills.title: Forecasting
skills.detail: Trend and seasonality, moving averages, ML forecasts.

skills.title: Marketing analytics
skills.detail: Attribution, campaign ROI, CAC by channel.

stages.title: Data engineering basics
stages.summary: Enough modern data stack to own your pipelines end to end.

skills.title: Data modelling
skills.detail: Star schema, facts and dimensions, grain.

skills.title: ETL and dbt
skills.detail: Transform in the warehouse, tests, documentation.

skills.title: Cloud warehouses
skills.detail: BigQuery or Snowflake: loading, costs, partitions.

skills.title: Git for analysts
skills.detail: Version your SQL and notebooks; PRs for analysis.

stages.title: Portfolio and job hunt
stages.summary: Proof of work and the interview loop: SQL rounds, case studies and take-homes.

skills.title: Five polished case studies
skills.detail: Business question, method, insight, recommendation, dashboard.

skills.title: Analyst resume and LinkedIn
skills.detail: Impact bullets with numbers; tools section that matches postings.

skills.title: SQL interview rounds
skills.detail: Timed medium/hard SQL, explaining your query out loud.

skills.title: Case interviews
skills.detail: Metric drops, root-cause, product sense questions.

skills.title: A recognised certificate
skills.detail: Google Data Analytics, PL-300 or Tableau certification.

paths.title: Computational Designer
paths.subtitle: Architect · Sustainable designer
paths.tagline: Design buildings with code and climate data: parametric tools, simulation and low-carbon thinking.

stages.title: Design foundations
stages.summary: Think and draw like an architect: space, light, structure and materials.

learn.t: Ching: Architecture, Form, Space and Order

skills.title: Architectural drawing
skills.detail: Plans, sections, elevations, scale, line weights, axonometrics.

skills.title: Design principles
skills.detail: Proportion, rhythm, hierarchy, circulation, spatial sequence.

skills.title: Building construction
skills.detail: Structure, envelope, assemblies, how buildings are actually made.

skills.title: Materials and their impact
skills.detail: Timber, concrete, steel, earth, bamboo; embodied carbon of each.

skills.title: AutoCAD 2D
skills.detail: Layers, blocks, xrefs, clean drawing sets.

skills.title: Precedent studies
skills.detail: Analyse 10 great buildings: diagrams of form, light and climate.

stages.title: 3D modelling and visualisation
stages.summary: From sketch to model to image: the tools every design studio expects.

skills.title: Rhino NURBS modelling
skills.detail: Curves, surfaces, solids, Make2D, clean geometry.

skills.title: Massing and SketchUp
skills.detail: Fast concept massing and site models.

skills.title: Rendering
skills.detail: Enscape, V-Ray or Twinmotion: lighting, materials, cameras.

skills.title: Presentation graphics
skills.detail: Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign for boards and portfolios.

stages.title: Parametric design
stages.summary: Design with rules instead of lines. Grasshopper is the industry standard.

skills.title: Grasshopper basics
skills.detail: Components, lists, domains, series, the data flow mindset.

skills.title: Data trees
skills.detail: Branches, paths, graft, flatten, simplify. The key unlock.

skills.title: Parametric patterns and facades
skills.detail: Attractor points, panelling, Voronoi, perforated skins.

skills.title: Form-finding
skills.detail: Kangaroo physics: tensile, gridshells, relaxation.

skills.title: Meshes and subdivision
skills.detail: Weaverbird, mesh smoothing, mesh to fabrication.

skills.title: Plugin ecosystem
skills.detail: Lunchbox, Pufferfish, Human, Elefront from Food4Rhino.

stages.title: Computational scripting
stages.summary: Where your programming background becomes a superpower in design.

skills.title: Python in Rhino and Grasshopper
skills.detail: GhPython / Python 3 components, rhinoscriptsyntax, RhinoCommon.

skills.title: C# scripting
skills.detail: C# components and simple Grasshopper plugins.

skills.title: Computational geometry
skills.detail: Vectors, planes, transforms, curve and surface evaluation.

skills.title: Web and data exchange
skills.detail: Rhino.Compute, Hops, Speckle, three.js for sharing models online.

stages.title: BIM
stages.summary: How real buildings get documented and delivered.

skills.title: Revit modelling
skills.detail: Walls, floors, families, views, sheets, schedules.

skills.title: Dynamo for Revit
skills.detail: Automate Revit with visual scripts and Python nodes.

skills.title: Rhino.Inside.Revit and IFC
skills.detail: Move parametric geometry into BIM; open standards.

stages.title: Environmental analysis
stages.summary: Simulate sun, daylight, energy, wind and comfort before anything is built.

skills.title: Climate analysis
skills.detail: EPW weather files, sun paths, wind roses, psychrometric charts in Ladybug.

skills.title: Solar radiation and shading
skills.detail: Radiation studies, shadow hours, shading device design.

skills.title: Daylight simulation
skills.detail: Honeybee-Radiance: daylight factor, sDA, ASE, glare.

skills.title: Energy modelling
skills.detail: Honeybee-Energy with EnergyPlus/OpenStudio: loads, EUI.

skills.title: Wind and CFD
skills.detail: Outdoor wind comfort and natural ventilation (Eddy3D, Butterfly).

skills.title: Thermal comfort
skills.detail: UTCI, PMV, adaptive comfort maps.

stages.title: Sustainable design
stages.summary: Design buildings that use less, emit less and feel better, and prove it.

skills.title: Passive design strategies
skills.detail: Orientation, shading, thermal mass, cross ventilation for hot-humid India.

skills.title: Green rating systems
skills.detail: LEED, IGBC and GRIHA: credits, documentation, process.

skills.title: Energy codes
skills.detail: ECBC (India), ASHRAE 90.1 basics, compliance paths.

skills.title: Embodied carbon and LCA
skills.detail: Whole-life carbon with One Click LCA or EC3.

skills.title: Net zero and renewables
skills.detail: Load reduction first, then solar PV sizing and offsets.

skills.title: Water and site
skills.detail: Rainwater harvesting, landscape, heat island mitigation.

stages.title: Optimisation and AI for design
stages.summary: Your edge: combine machine learning with design to explore thousands of options.

skills.title: Multi-objective optimisation
skills.detail: Galapagos, Wallacei, Octopus: trade off daylight, energy and cost.

skills.title: ML surrogate models
skills.detail: Train models that predict simulation results in milliseconds.

skills.title: Generative AI for design
skills.detail: Diffusion models, ControlNet, image-to-3D for concept exploration.

skills.title: Digital fabrication
skills.detail: Laser cutting, 3D printing, CNC, robotic fabrication basics.

stages.title: Portfolio and practice
stages.summary: Show your process and land a role in a design, consulting or sustainability firm.

skills.title: Computational design portfolio
skills.detail: Process diagrams, scripts, simulation results, final images.

skills.title: Three case studies with metrics
skills.detail: Before/after energy, daylight or carbon numbers for each.

skills.title: Community and visibility
skills.detail: Share definitions online, join hackathons and AEC tech meetups.

skills.title: Applications to studios and consultancies
skills.detail: Computational designer, sustainability analyst, BIM specialist roles.

trackers.title: Green certifications
trackers.sub: LEED GA, IGBC AP or GRIHA CP
